summary: Materialized SCTA AQUINAS-ST-I-Q48-A5 in full. Operational absence and defective due mode/order are both included in the directional culpa classification; control by will and due operation survive as conditions. Rejected unrestricted division of all evil into poena/culpa because ad 2 expressly restricts it to voluntary things. The article gives no actual culprit witness; the derived answer cell is conditional only, with the absent-operation branch yielding privative evil through the existing q48a3 account. Exhaustive/converse readings and poena classification remain unformalized. No premise truth, root closure, rebuttal of naturalistic moral realism, or explanation of divine permission is claimed.
